evaluation: Reload every frozen checkpoint and apply its saved threshold once to the shared test cohort. No fitting, epoch selection, recalibration, seed selection, pruning or label/split changes.
comparison: Explicit cross-preparation comparison requires identical snapshot, target, item IDs and labels. Report both policies, all seeds, mean/sample-std/min/max and validation-to-test differences.
test_exposure: Write an exposure ledger on first test-byte access. After this final, same test is used evidence and cannot be claimed untouched for new model improvements.
improvement_policy: New hypotheses use development/group-CV. A new confirmatory claim needs a genuinely independent holdout; old-test re-evaluations must be labelled exploratory.
